title: Korean-Style Zesty Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and spicy rice bowl dish made with Korean chili flakes and a zesty twist. This easy-to-make recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly browned.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked mixed rice to the pan and stir to combine with the potatoes and chili flakes.
Add the zesty sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is heated through.
Stir in the fresh baby spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve hot in bowls and garnish with additional zesty sauce if desired.
